full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn animated illustration places an elderly man and a younger figure in front of a densely ornamented circular background. The older man stands on the left, tall and slender, with swept white hair, a pointed white beard and a long dark green cloak. He faces left and lifts his gaze slightly. The smaller figure stands near the center in layered olive and cream clothing, with pale hair, folded arms and large blue eyes looking upward to the right. Behind them, broad gold ribbons curl into tight spirals across a deep teal field. Smaller interlaced knots, pale rings and leaflike marks fill almost every opening. A small round animal face with yellow eyes appears low on the right, and another pale creature peers from a spiral behind the older figure. The circular ornament sits inside a square border of darker patterned green, giving the characters a flat emblematic stage. Forms are outlined with fine dark lines and filled with muted, nearly flat colors. The cloaked vertical and the younger compact figure interrupt the sweeping curves without removing their rhythm. Light is even and soft; pale hair and faces stand out against the darker green, while gold lines provide the brightest accents. Slight paperlike grain and repeated decorative marks make the image feel hand-crafted. The space is shallow, but overlapping spirals and bodies create several close layers. The whole image balances still character poses with continuous swirling motion, joining a quiet encounter to an intricate illuminated-manuscript pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘动画插画把一位老人和一名年轻人物放在纹饰密集的圆形背景前。老人高瘦，站在左边，白发向后梳起，留尖白胡子，披长深绿斗篷。他向左，目光略向上抬。较小的人物站在中央附近，穿橄榄色和奶油色层叠衣服，浅发、双臂交叠，蓝色大眼向右上看。两人身后，宽阔金色带在深青绿色域里卷成紧密螺旋。较细的交织结、浅色圆环和叶状笔痕填满几乎所有空隙。右下方出现一张黄眼小动物圆脸，另一只浅色生物从老人后面的螺旋中探出。圆形纹饰处在更深的花纹绿方框内，让人物置身于扁平徽章般的舞台。形体由细暗线勾住，再填以低饱和、近乎平面的颜色。长斗篷的竖线和年轻人物的紧凑形体打断卷曲线，却没有消除其节奏。光均匀柔和；浅发与面孔从深绿前显出，金线提供最亮强调。轻微纸张颗粒与重复装饰笔痕使图像有手工制作感。空间浅，但螺旋与身体遮挡形成几个贴近的层次。整体图像以静止人物姿势平衡持续旋动，把安静相遇接到繁复的彩饰手抄本纹样上。
style_prompt_en: The image has a hand-drawn animation surface with fine dark contours, matte flat color and delicate paperlike grain. Deep teal and olive cover the largest areas, while gold and pale cream lines trace broad spirals and tiny interlaced details. Circular movement is the main structural rhythm, interrupted by a few clear vertical and compact shapes. Most edges are crisply drawn, but the low-contrast palette keeps the whole field visually unified. Light is diffuse and even; brightness comes chiefly from pale areas and gold linework rather than modeled highlights. Layers overlap closely and flatten the perspective, giving ornament and focal forms nearly equal visual presence. Repeating knots, curls and leaflike marks create density without obscuring the larger circular design. The frame remains active at every edge, with little blank space. The overall effect is intimate and enchanted, grounded in precise graphic order and the tactile softness of an illustrated page.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有手绘动画表面，细暗轮廓、哑光平色和轻微纸张颗粒结合。深青绿与橄榄色占据最大面积，金线和浅奶油色线描出宽螺旋与细小交结。圆形运动是主要结构节奏，被少数清楚竖形和紧凑形状打断。大多数边缘由准确线条圈定，但低对比调色让整块色域仍统一。光漫射均匀；亮度主要来自浅色面积和金色线条，而非塑形高光。层次紧密遮挡并压平透视，使纹饰和焦点形体几乎同等在场。反复结纹、卷曲线和叶状笔痕制造密度，却没有遮没较大的圆形设计。画框的每个边缘都保持活跃，几乎没有空白。整体效果亲近而带奇幻感，依靠准确图形秩序和插画纸页的可触柔软感站稳。
theme_en: An elderly white-haired man and a pale young figure stand before a dense circular field of green and gold spirals
theme_zh: 一位白发老人和一名浅发年轻人立于密集绿金螺旋圆纹之前
name: The Secret of Kells
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
